newsitem.title: UK: C-S pleased by EC noises over CCSB deal.
newsitem.headline: C-S pleased by EC noises over CCSB deal.

text.p: Drinks and confectionery company Cadbury-Schweppes(C-S) said on Wednesday it is pleased by indications the European Commission will clear the acquisition by Coca-Cola Enterprises Inc of C-S's 51 percent stake in British bottler CCSB later this month. But a spokeswoman for the company said it was awaiting final approval from the Commission. Earlier an unnamed European Union source in Brussels confirmed the Commission's merger task force was likely to clear the deal. "We understand that the EC's advisory committee appears to have accepted the Commissions provisional recommendations that the proposed sale of CCSB to CCE should be permitted to proceed," said a Cadbury-Schweppes spokeswoman.
"We are pleased with this development but await final approval following the European Commission's meeting later this month," the spokeswoman for the company.
A final decision is expected on January 22.
